text: The snapshotting, just real quick on that. When a change is made, we want to probably use a skill, so every time any file changes are made, the skill is loaded. It puts fresh context into the LLM that gives specific instructions about what to do. Like, make a commit probably, if it passes all the UI tests. So we probably commit last. You make the file changes, you take the screenshot, you look at it. We don't want the designer of the UI who's writing the code to also have to load up Playwright and take the screenshot. It takes too long, because the LLM has to do all this processing between each step. So what we would want is the minion who designed the UI to use the skill that then triggers an already running Playwright instance, pre-configured for that page URL. Whatever page URLs are being edited in real time has a monitor for it and takes a screenshot immediately, probably at each resolution, and makes sure that everything checks out. Those screenshots could go into a specific location, and the communication between the minion and the monitor would vary. Maybe we want a cheap model monitor minion, or just a process that can execute. Or the minion manages it, maybe the minion starts up the Playwright and keeps it running. Maybe it shouldn't be that hard. I don't know how much time it should take, maybe we need to measure this. We need to get a timeline.
